task.description:
REWORK 1: The transition() function and test cases in src/engine/transition.zig are stubs. Implement the full function body and all 11 unit tests.

[HIGH] All EE-02 test cases (TC-EE-02-01 through TC-EE-02-11) are present but not implemented. Requirement EE-02 is not validated by tests.

## What to do

The file `src/engine/transition.zig` already has the correct types (Token, InstanceState, TransitionEvent, TransitionError). You only need to:

### 1. Implement the transition() function

Replace the stub `return TransitionError.InvalidState;` with the full algorithm from `src/design/engine.md §6`.

The design doc specifies exact algorithms for each node type. Read §6.1 through §6.7 carefully. Key points:
- START event: seed variables from `initial_variables`, place token on the node after START, call processNodeEntry()
- task_completed event: locate token on task_node_id, merge output_variables into state.variables, advance token, call processNodeEntry()
- unknown event: return TransitionError.UnknownEventType
- Precondition check: for each token, verify node_id exists in snapshot — TokenOnMissingNode if missing

### 2. Implement processNodeEntry() helper

Replace the stub with the actual dispatch:
- END: remove arriving token, if no remaining non-END tokens → status=COMPLETED
- HUMAN_TASK (entry): token stays on node, append node_id to pending_task_nodes
- EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY: iterate outgoing edges in order, evaluate CEL, follow first true; fallback to default; NoMatchingEdge if none
- PARALLEL_GATEWAY split (>1 outgoing): create N tokens with unique branch_ids, remove arriving token
- PARALLEL_GATEWAY join (>1 incoming): check if all incoming branches have arrived; if yes merge to single token on outgoing; if no park token and return state unchanged

### 3. CEL evaluation

Read `vendor/cel/` to understand the evaluator API. Use it for EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY condition evaluation. CEL runtime errors must be treated as false for that edge (not a fatal error).

### 4. Implement unit tests

Replace each TODO comment in the test block with real test assertions.

For tests that require a DefinitionGraph, build minimal in-memory graphs directly — look at how graph.zig tests construct test graphs. You do NOT need a database.

Required tests:
- TC-EE-02-01: instance_started event places token on first non-START node (e.g. a HUMAN_TASK)
- TC-EE-02-02: task_completed on HUMAN_TASK advances to next node
- TC-EE-02-03: token reaches END → status becomes COMPLETED
- TC-EE-02-04: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY follows first true CEL condition
- TC-EE-02-05: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with no true condition and no default → NoMatchingEdge error
- TC-EE-02-06: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY default edge fallback
- TC-EE-02-07: PARALLEL_GATEWAY split creates N tokens
- TC-EE-02-08: PARALLEL_GATEWAY join waits until all tokens arrive, then merges
- TC-EE-02-09: unknown event type → UnknownEventType error
- TC-EE-02-10: token on missing node → TokenOnMissingNode error
- TC-EE-02-11: same inputs called twice → identical output (determinism)

Use `std.testing.allocator` as the allocator in tests.

### 5. Validate

```
zig build
zig build test
```

Both must exit 0. Tests must PASS (not be empty/skipped).

Complete the handoff when done.
acceptance_criteria: transition() function fully implemented (not a stub)
processNodeEntry() helper fully implemented (not a stub)
TC-EE-02-01 through TC-EE-02-11 have real assertions (not TODO/empty)
zig build test exits 0 with tests actually running

result.summary: Implemented full transition() and processNodeEntry() logic in src/engine/transition.zig per design doc. All 11 unit tests (TC-EE-02-01 through TC-EE-02-11) now have real assertions and pass. Build and tests exit 0.
